name: X-ray, Neutron & Synchrotron Methods
summary: Applies diffraction and scattering to identify phases, measure strain and texture, and probe structure from atoms to microns.

topics.name: Generating X-rays: tubes, characteristic spectra and filters; synchrotron sources
Powder diffractometer geometry and data collection
Phase identification with the PDF database
Quantitative phase analysis and Rietveld refinement
Crystallite size and microstrain from peak broadening (Scherrer, Williamson-Hall)
Texture measurement: pole figures and orientation distribution functions
Thin-film methods: grazing incidence, reflectivity and high-resolution XRD
Neutron diffraction: light elements, magnetic structure and bulk residual stress
X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XANES/EXAFS) and X-ray fluorescence
In-situ and operando diffraction at synchrotrons
